samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation using a dual-port RAM module.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data to be written into the FIFO.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output. The width [WIDTH-1:0] is configurable and represents the data read from the FIFO.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">Data width parameter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH" value="16">FIFO depth parameter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Combinational logic to calculate the binary representation of the write pointer
        assign waddr_bin[3] = wptr[3];
        assign waddr_bin[2] = wptr[3]^wptr[2];
        assign waddr_bin[1] = wptr[2]^wptr[1];
        assign waddr_bin[0] = wptr[1]^wptr[0];
        
        // Combinational logic to calculate the binary representation of the read pointer
        assign raddr_bin[3] = rptr[3];
        assign raddr_bin[2] = rptr[3]^rptr[2];
        assign raddr_bin[1] = rptr[2]^rptr[1];
        assign raddr_bin[0] = rptr[1]^rptr[0];
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the write clock
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if(~wrstn) begin
                // Reset the write pointer to 0 on reset signal
                wptr <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                // Update the write pointer based on the write increment signal
                wptr <= wptr + winc;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the negative edge of the read clock
        always @(negedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if(~rrstn) begin
                // Reset the read pointer to 0 on reset signal
                rptr <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                // Update the read pointer based on the read increment signal
                rptr <= rptr + rinc;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the write clock
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if(~wrstn) begin
                // Reset the write pointer buffer to 0 on reset signal
                wptr_buff <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                // Store the previous value of the write pointer in the buffer
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of the read clock
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if(~rrstn) begin
                // Reset the read pointer buffer to 0 on reset signal
                rptr_buff <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                // Store the previous value of the read pointer in the buffer
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Combinational logic to check if the FIFO is full
        assign wfull = (wptr == {~rptr_buff[3], rptr_buff[2:0]});
        
        // Combinational logic to check if the FIFO is empty
        assign rempty = (rptr_syn == wptr);
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Instantiation of dual-port RAM module
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram(
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(winc & !wfull),
            .waddr(waddr_bin),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(rinc & !rempty),
            .raddr(raddr_bin),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
    </implementation>
    <task>
        <id>update_pointer_buffer</id>
        <description>Update the pointer buffers on the rising edges of the write and read clocks.</description>
        <sequence>
            <step>On the positive edge of the write clock:</step>
            <substeps>
                <if condition="not(wrstn)">
                    <then>Set the write pointer buffer to 0.</then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>Store the previous value of the write pointer in the buffer.</then>
                </else>
            </substeps>
            <step>On the positive edge of the read clock:</step>
            <substeps>
                <if condition="not(rrstn)">
                    <then>Set the read pointer buffer to 0.</then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>Store the previous value of the read pointer in the buffer.</then>
                </else>
            </substeps>
        </sequence>
    </task>
    <task>
        <id>check_full_empty</id>
        <description>Check if the FIFO is full or empty and update the corresponding flags.</description>
        <sequence>
            <step>Compare the current write and read pointers (wptr and rptr_syn).</step>
            <substeps>
                <if condition="wptr equals {~rptr_buff[3], rptr_buff[2:0]}">
                    <then>Set the write full flag to 1.</then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>Set the write full flag to 0.</then>
                </else>
                
                <if condition="rptr_syn equals wptr">
                    <then>Set the read empty flag to 1.</then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>Set the read empty flag to 0.</then>
                </else>
            </substeps>
        </sequence>
    </task>
</module>
